newsitem.title: USA: Huntsman buys Amoco's polystyrene business.
newsitem.headline: Huntsman buys Amoco's polystyrene business.

text.p: Privately-held Huntsman Corp said Thursday that it has signed an agreement with Amoco Corp's chemical company to buy its polystyrene business.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed. The business had 1995 revenues of about $120 million, Huntsman said.
Included are Amoco's two polystyrene manufacturing plants at Joliet and Willow Springs, Illinois, Huntsman said.
In August, Huntsman had said it was in final negotiation stages to buy the polymers unit of a public company.

It said the acquisition brings its annual polystyrene production capacity in the United States to about 1.5 billion pounds. It added that it would annouce "additional polystyrene expansions in the near future."
Polystyrene is used in making foam food packaging and home insulation products.
